content.raw_text: 赫敏揉着额头说：“如果不是克劳奇袭击了克鲁姆，那就是有什么东西趁克鲁姆不注意时袭击了他们。”罗恩立刻说：“肯定是克劳奇，所以哈利和邓布利多赶到时他已经不见了。”哈利摇头说：“我觉得不是，他看上去很虚弱，不像能幻影移形。”赫敏提醒道：“在霍格沃茨不能幻影移形，我说过很多次了。”

sentences.text: 赫敏揉着额头说：“如果不是克劳奇袭击了克鲁姆，那就是有什么东西趁克鲁姆不注意时袭击了他们。
sentences.translation: Hermione rubbed her forehead and said, 'If it wasn't Crouch attacking Krum, then something must have attacked them while Krum wasn't paying attention.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a conditional structure '如果...，那就是...' (if... then it must be...), and the use of '趁' to indicate taking advantage of a situation.

sentences.text: ”罗恩立刻说：“肯定是克劳奇，所以哈利和邓布利多赶到时他已经不见了。
sentences.translation: Ron immediately said, 'It must be Crouch, so when Harry and Dumbledore arrived, he was already gone.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese places the time element before the action, which may be different from English.

sentences.text: ”哈利摇头说：“我觉得不是，他看上去很虚弱，不像能幻影移形。
sentences.translation: Harry shook his head and said, 'I don't think so. He looks very weak, not like he can do a Disillusionment Charm.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a comparison structure '不像' (not like) and introduces the concept of a specific magical charm '幻影移形' (Disillusionment Charm).

sentences.text: ”赫敏提醒道：“在霍格沃茨不能幻影移形，我说过很多次了。
sentences.translation: Hermione reminded, 'You can't use the Animagus transformation at Hogwarts, I've said it many times.'
sentences.explanation: This sentence includes the grammar structure '在...不能...' to express 'cannot do something at a certain place.' The term '幻影移形' refers to the Animagus transformation in the Harry Potter series.
This sentence only contains a closing quotation mark and a space, with no actual text to translate.

content.raw_text: 罗恩兴奋地猜测：“会不会是克鲁姆袭击了克劳奇，然后给自己念了个昏迷咒？”赫敏冷冷地说：“克劳奇先生变成蒸气挥发了，是不是？”

sentences.text: 罗恩兴奋地猜测：“会不会是克鲁姆袭击了克劳奇，然后给自己念了个昏迷咒？
sentences.translation: Ron excitedly speculated: 'Could it be that Krum attacked Crouch, then put himself into a coma spell?'
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure involves a speculation followed by a question, with a complex verb-object construction involving the verb '给' (to) and the reflexive pronoun '自己' (oneself).

sentences.text: ”赫敏冷冷地说：“克劳奇先生变成蒸气挥发了，是不是？
sentences.translation: Hermione coldly said, 'Did Mr. Crouch turn into vapor and evaporate?'
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a question structure with the word '是不是' (shì bù shì) at the end, which is a common way to form yes-no questions in Chinese.
This sentence only contains a closing quotation mark and a space, with no actual text content.

content.raw_text: 天刚亮，哈利、罗恩和赫敏就去猫头鹰棚屋给小天狼星发信。他们讨论克劳奇先生的事讨论到很晚，都显得很疲惫。赫敏让哈利再讲一遍克劳奇先生说了什么，哈利说：“他语无伦次，说要提醒邓布利多，提到了伯莎·乔金斯，说她死了，还提到了他的儿子。”赫敏说：“那当然是他的错。”哈利解释：“他精神错乱了，有时以为妻子和儿子还活着，还跟珀西讲工作上的事。”

sentences.text: 天刚亮，哈利，罗恩和赫敏就去猫头鹰棚屋给小天狼星发信。
sentences.translation: Just as the day broke, Harry, Ron, and Hermione went to the owl shed to send a letter to Sirius.
sentences.explanation: The structure '就...就...' is used to indicate that an action is done immediately or promptly after another action. In this sentence, it emphasizes that Harry, Ron, and Hermione wasted no time in going to the owl shed to send a letter to Sirius as soon as the day broke.

sentences.text: 他们讨论克劳奇先生的事讨论到很晚，都显得很疲惫。
sentences.translation: They discussed Mr. Krauch's affairs until very late, all looking very tired.
sentences.explanation: The structure '都...显得' is used to indicate that all of them appeared a certain way, in this case, very tired.

sentences.text: 赫敏让哈利再讲一遍克劳奇先生说了什么，哈利说：“他语无伦次，说要提醒邓布利多，提到了伯莎·乔金斯，说她死了，还提到了他的儿子。
sentences.translation: Hermione asked Harry to repeat what Mr. Crouch said. Harry said, 'He was incoherent, mentioning about reminding Dumbledore, mentioning Bertha Jorkins's death, and also mentioning his son.'
sentences.explanation: This sentence includes the structure of '说...，说...，说...' to indicate a series of things mentioned by Mr. Crouch.

sentences.text: ”赫敏说：“那当然是他的错。
sentences.translation: Hermione said: "Of course, that's his fault."
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Verb + Object. The possessive particle '的' is used to indicate possession in this context.

sentences.text: ”哈利解释：“他精神错乱了，有时以为妻子和儿子还活着，还跟珀西讲工作上的事。
sentences.translation: Harry explained: "He is mentally disturbed, sometimes he thinks his wife and son are still alive, and he talks to Percy about work."
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the structure of using "有时" (sometimes) followed by "以为" (think) to indicate a temporary belief or misconception.
The sentence is empty, consisting only of a closing quotation mark and a space.

content.raw_text: 罗恩问：“他说神秘人什么来着？”哈利回答：“他说那人在强壮起来。”罗恩试图安慰自己：“他精神错乱了，可能有一半是疯话。”哈利说：“提到伏地魔时他最清醒，他不停地说要见邓布利多。”

sentences.text: 罗恩问：“他说神秘人什么来着？
sentences.translation: Ron asked: "What did the mysterious person say?"
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Verb + Object. The word "来着" at the end of the sentence is a colloquial way to indicate that an action or state has been completed.

words.definition: indicates completion of an action or state

sentences.text: ”哈利回答：“他说那人在强壮起来。
sentences.translation: Harry replied: 'He said that person is getting stronger.'
sentences.explanation: The structure '在...起来' is used to indicate that someone or something is in the process of becoming a certain way, in this case, 'getting stronger.'

sentences.text: ”罗恩试图安慰自己：“他精神错乱了，可能有一半是疯话。
sentences.translation: Ron tried to comfort himself: "He is mentally disturbed, maybe half of it is nonsense."
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the structure of using '可能' (maybe) followed by '有' (have) to indicate possibility in Chinese. It also demonstrates the use of quotation marks to indicate direct speech.

sentences.text: ”哈利说：“提到伏地魔时他最清醒，他不停地说要见邓布利多。
sentences.translation: Harry said: "When it comes to Voldemort, he is most lucid, constantly saying he wants to see Dumbledore."
sentences.explanation: This sentence demonstrates the structure of using "时" to indicate a specific time or situation, and the use of adverbial marker "地" to modify the verb.
The sentence consists of a closing quotation mark and a space.

content.raw_text: 哈利抱怨说：“要不是斯内普截住我，我们能及时赶到。”罗恩猜测：“也许斯内普不希望你们赶到。”赫敏建议去见穆迪教授，看他找到克劳奇先生没有。哈利说：“如果他带着活点地图，找起来应该不难。”罗恩补充：“除非克劳奇已经出了这片场地。”

sentences.text: 哈利抱怨说：“要不是斯内普截住我，我们能及时赶到。
sentences.translation: Harry complained, "If it weren't for Snape stopping me, we could have arrived on time."
sentences.explanation: The structure '要不是...，...' is used to express 'if it weren't for...'. The word '截住' means 'to stop' in this context.

sentences.text: ”罗恩猜测：“也许斯内普不希望你们赶到。
sentences.translation: Ron guessed: 'Perhaps Snape does not want you to arrive.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Verb + Object. The use of '也许' (perhaps) indicates uncertainty or speculation.

sentences.text: ”赫敏建议去见穆迪教授，看他找到克劳奇先生没有。
sentences.translation: Hermione suggested going to see Professor Moody to see if he found Mr. Crouch or not.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure follows the pattern of suggesting someone to do something using the verb '建议' (suggest). The word '看' (to see) is used twice in this sentence to express the idea of checking or confirming something.

sentences.text: 哈利说：“如果他带着活点地图，找起来应该不难。
sentences.translation: Harry said: 'If he brings a live map, it shouldn't be hard to find.'
sentences.explanation: The structure '如果...，找起来应该不难' is a common way to express 'should not be hard to...' in Chinese.

words.definition: live (here refers to a map that shows real-time information)

sentences.text: ”罗恩补充：“除非克劳奇已经出了这片场地。
sentences.translation: Ron added, 'Unless Crouch has already left this area.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is a conditional statement using the word '除非' (unless). The tricky part might be understanding the use of '已经' (already) before the verb '出' (left).
The sentence ends with a quotation mark followed by an ellipsis, indicating a pause or continuation in the text.

content.raw_text: 赫敏突然让他们安静，因为有人在楼梯上朝猫头鹰棚屋走来。是弗雷德和乔治，他们在争吵。弗雷德和乔治进来后，看到哈利他们，显得很惊讶。罗恩问他们在干什么，弗雷德说：“发信。”乔治补充：“我们不问你们在干吗，你们也别问我们。”

sentences.text: 赫敏突然让他们安静，因为有人在楼梯上朝猫头鹰棚屋走来。
sentences.translation: Hermione suddenly made them quiet, because someone was walking towards the owl shed on the stairs.
sentences.explanation: The structure '因为' (because) is used to indicate the reason for Hermione's action. The phrase '朝...走来' (walking towards) is a directional phrase indicating movement towards a specific location.

sentences.text: 是弗雷德和乔治，他们在争吵。
sentences.translation: It's Fred and George, they are arguing.
sentences.explanation: The structure '在 + verb' is used to indicate an action in progress. In this sentence, it shows that Fred and George are currently arguing.

words.definition: at, in, on (indicates an action in progress)

sentences.text: 弗雷德和乔治进来后，看到哈利他们，显得很惊讶。
sentences.translation: After Fred and George came in, they looked very surprised to see Harry.
sentences.explanation: The structure '看到 + person' means 'see someone'. The word '显得' is used to indicate how someone appears or seems.

sentences.text: 罗恩问他们在干什么，弗雷德说：“发信。
sentences.translation: Ron asked them what they were doing, and Fred said: 'Sending a letter.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure follows a typical question-response format. The phrase '发信' means 'send a letter.'

sentences.text: ”乔治补充：“我们不问你在干吗，也别。
sentences.translation: George added: "We don't ask what you're doing, so don't ask us either."
sentences.explanation: The sentence demonstrates the use of parallel structure in Chinese to express reciprocity in not asking about each other's activities.

sentences.translation: The sentence is not provided.
sentences.explanation: The sentence provided is only quotation marks, indicating the beginning and end of a text or speech. No actual content is given for translation or analysis.

content.raw_text: 罗恩坚持问：“你们要敲诈谁？”弗雷德脸上的笑容消失了，乔治说：“别傻了，我是开玩笑的。”罗恩不相信，弗雷德威胁说：“要是你喜欢你鼻子现在的形状，就少管闲事。”罗恩说：“如果你们在敲诈，那就不是闲事。”

sentences.text: 罗恩坚持问：“你们要敲诈谁？
sentences.translation: Ron insisted, 'Who are you trying to blackmail?'
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is a simple question asking who the target of blackmail is. The use of the question mark at the end indicates it is a direct question.

sentences.text: ”弗雷德脸上的笑容消失了，乔治说：“别傻了，我是开玩笑的。
sentences.translation: Fred's smile disappeared, George said: "Don't be silly, I'm just joking."
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a possessive particle '的' to indicate possession, and a particle '了' to indicate the completion of an action. The structure '别傻了' is a common way to say 'Don't be silly' in Chinese.

sentences.text: ”罗恩不相信，弗雷德威胁说：“要是你喜欢你鼻子现在的形状，就少管闲事。
sentences.translation: Ron didn't believe it, Fred threatened: 'If you like the shape of your nose now, mind your own business.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a conditional structure '要是' (if), possessive particle '的', and the idiomatic phrase '管闲事' (mind one's own business).

sentences.text: ”罗恩说：“如果你们在敲诈，那就不是闲事。
sentences.translation: Ron said: 'If you are extorting, then it's not a trivial matter.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a conditional structure '如果...，那就...' which means 'if... then...' The word '敲诈' means 'extorting' in this context.
The sentence consists of opening and closing quotation marks.

content.raw_text: 弗雷德和乔治离开后，赫敏问：“你认为他们会知道什么情况吗？”哈利说：“不会，如果是严重的事，他们会告诉邓布利多。”但罗恩显得不安，说：“我不知道他们会不会。他们最近一心想着赚钱。”

sentences.text: 弗雷德和乔治离开后，赫敏问：“你认为他们会知道什么情况吗？
sentences.translation: After Fred and George left, Hermione asked, "Do you think they will know what's going on?"
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is Subject + Verb + Object. The question particle 吗 at the end indicates a yes-no question.

sentences.text: ”哈利说：“不会，如果是严重的事，他们会告诉邓布利多。
sentences.translation: Harry said: 'No, if it's something serious, they will tell Dumbledore.'
sentences.explanation: The structure 如果...会 (if...will) is commonly used in Chinese to express a conditional statement.

sentences.text: ”但罗恩显得不安，说：“我不知道他们会不会。
sentences.translation: But Ron looked uneasy and said, 'I don't know if they will.'
sentences.explanation: The structure '会不会' is used to express uncertainty or doubt in Chinese.

sentences.text: 他们最近一心想着赚钱。
sentences.translation: They recently have been single-mindedly thinking about making money.
sentences.explanation: The structure '一心想着' means 'single-mindedly thinking about' in this context.
The sentence is enclosed in quotation marks, indicating it is a direct quote or dialogue.

content.raw_text: 赫敏担心地说：“他们不会为了赚钱去干违法的事吧。”罗恩怀疑：“我不知道，他们不太管纪律。”赫敏建议：“你最好告诉珀西。”罗恩反对：“告诉珀西？他会告发他们的。”

sentences.text: 赫敏担心地说：“他们不会为了赚钱去干违法的事吧。
sentences.translation: Hermione worriedly said, 'They wouldn't do illegal things just to make money, right?'
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is a bit complex with the use of adverbial particles and the modal '会' to express likelihood.

sentences.text: ”罗恩怀疑：“我不知道，他们不太管纪律。
sentences.translation: Ron doubted: 'I don't know, they don't pay much attention to discipline.'
sentences.explanation: The structure '不太' means 'not very' or 'not too much'. In this sentence, it indicates that 'they' do not pay much attention to discipline.

sentences.text: ”赫敏建议：“你最好告诉珀西。
sentences.translation: Hermione suggested: 'You'd better tell Percy.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a suggestion structure using the phrase '最好' (had better), which is commonly used to advise someone on what they should do.

sentences.text: ”罗恩反对：“告诉珀西？
sentences.translation: Ron objected: "Tell Percy?
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is Subject + Verb + Object. The use of the colon and question mark at the end indicates a direct question being asked.

sentences.text: 他会告发他们的。
sentences.translation: He will report them.
sentences.explanation: The structure '会告发' means 'will report' in this context. '的' is a possessive particle indicating possession or relationship.
The sentence contains a closing quotation mark and an ellipsis, which are important punctuation marks in Chinese text.

content.raw_text: 他们决定去吃早饭。赫敏问：“现在去看穆迪教授是不是太早了？”哈利说：“是啊，等下课吧。”

sentences.text: 他们决定去吃早饭。
sentences.translation: They decided to go eat breakfast.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the structure of a basic Chinese sentence with the subject '他们' (they), the verb '决定' (decided), the direction particle '去' (to), the verb '吃' (eat), and the object '早饭' (breakfast).

sentences.text: 赫敏问：“现在去看穆迪教授是不是太早了？
sentences.translation: Hermione asked: 'Is it too early to go see Professor Moody now?'
sentences.explanation: The structure '是不是' is used to form a yes-no question in Chinese. In this sentence, it is asking whether it is too early to go see Professor Moody.

words.definition: indicates completion of action or change of state

sentences.text: ”哈利说：“是啊，等下课吧。
sentences.translation: Harry said: "Yes, let's wait until after class."
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is Subject + Verb + Object. The particle '吧' at the end softens the suggestion, making it more polite.

words.definition: modal particle indicating suggestion or request

sentences.explanation: The sentence is enclosed in quotation marks, indicating that it is a direct quote or dialogue.

content.raw_text: 魔法史课很慢，哈利不停看罗恩的手表。下课铃响后，他们去找穆迪教授。穆迪看上去也很疲惫。他让他们进教室，关上门。哈利问：“你找到克劳奇先生了吗？”穆迪说：“没有。”哈利问：“你用地图了吗？”穆迪说：“用了，但哪儿都找不到他。”

sentences.text: 魔法史课很慢，哈利不停看罗恩的手表。
sentences.translation: The History of Magic class is very slow, Harry keeps looking at Ron's watch.
sentences.explanation: The structure '不停' means 'without stopping' and is used to indicate continuous action.

sentences.text: 下课铃响后，他们去找穆迪教授。
sentences.translation: After the bell rang, they went to find Professor Moody.
sentences.explanation: The structure '下课铃响后' means 'after the bell rang', which is a common way to indicate a sequence of events in Chinese.

sentences.text: 穆迪看上去也很疲惫。
sentences.translation: Moody also looks very tired.
sentences.explanation: The structure '看上去' is a common way in Chinese to indicate how something appears or looks.

sentences.text: 他让他们进教室，关上门。
sentences.translation: He let them into the classroom, and closed the door.
sentences.explanation: The structure '让...进' means 'let...into' in this context. Also, '关上' is a compound verb meaning 'close'.

sentences.text: 哈利问：“你找到克劳奇先生了吗？
sentences.translation: Harry asked: "Have you found Mr. Crouch?"
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is a simple question in Chinese, with the question particle '吗' at the end to indicate a yes-no question.

sentences.text: ”穆迪说：“没有。
sentences.translation: Moody said, "No."
sentences.explanation: The sentence is a simple dialogue where Moody responds with a negative answer.

sentences.text: ”哈利问：“你用地图了吗？
sentences.translation: Harry asked: "Have you used the map?"
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is a simple question in Chinese, with the question particle '吗' at the end to indicate a yes-no question.

sentences.text: ”穆迪说：“用了，但哪儿都找不到他。
sentences.translation: Moody said: 'Used it, but couldn't find him anywhere.'
sentences.explanation: The structure '哪儿都' means 'everywhere'. The use of '了' indicates the completion of the action of using something.

sentences.translation: The man said, "I'm sorry."
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a direct quote within double quotation marks. The phrase '对不起' means 'I'm sorry.'

content.raw_text: 赫敏问：“他靠自己力量离开的吗？”穆迪说：“可能被人弄走的。”罗恩问：“你认为他在霍格莫德村吗？”穆迪说：“在任何地方都可能。”

sentences.text: 赫敏问：“他靠自己力量离开的吗？
sentences.translation: Hermione asked: 'Did he leave on his own strength?'
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains a question structure using the particle '吗' at the end to indicate a yes-no question. The word '的' is used to indicate possession in this context.

words.definition: particle indicating past tense or possession

sentences.text: ”穆迪说：“可能被人弄走的。
sentences.translation: Moody said: "Possibly taken away by someone."
sentences.explanation: The structure '可能被' indicates a passive construction in Chinese, where the subject receives the action of the verb.

sentences.text: ”罗恩问：“你认为他在霍格莫德村吗？
sentences.translation: Ron asked: "Do you think he is in Hogsmeade village?"
sentences.explanation: The sentence is a question structure in Chinese, where the question particle '吗' is used at the end to indicate a yes-no question.

sentences.text: ”穆迪说：“在任何地方都可能。
sentences.translation: Moody said: "It could be anywhere."
sentences.explanation: The structure '在...都可能' is a common way to express 'could be anywhere' in Chinese.
The sentence consists of a closing quotation mark and a space.

content.raw_text: 穆迪提醒哈利专心准备第三个项目。哈利说：“好吧。”穆迪说：“保持警惕，波特。”他让罗恩和赫敏紧跟着哈利。

sentences.text: 穆迪提醒哈利专心准备第三个项目。
sentences.translation: Moody reminded Harry to focus on preparing for the third task.
sentences.explanation: The structure '专心准备' means 'to focus on preparing', which might be a new grammar pattern for learners to understand.

sentences.text: 哈利说：“好吧。
sentences.translation: Harry said: "Okay."
sentences.explanation: The sentence is a simple dialogue where Harry agrees with something by saying 'Okay.'

words.definition: used at the end of a sentence to suggest agreement or acceptance

sentences.text: ”穆迪说：“保持警惕，波特。
sentences.translation: Moody said: 'Stay alert, Potter.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a command structure where Moody is advising Potter to stay alert.

sentences.text: ”他让罗恩和赫敏紧跟着哈利。
sentences.translation: He let Ron and Hermione follow Harry closely.
sentences.explanation: The structure '让...跟着...' means 'let/follow closely'.

content.raw_text: 第二天，小天狼星的信来了。赫敏拿起《预言家日报》说：“那女人还不知道克劳奇的事！”他们读小天狼星的信。小天狼星警告哈利不要半夜出去，说霍格沃茨有危险的人物。

sentences.text: 第二天，小天狼星的信来了。
sentences.translation: The next day, Sirius's letter arrived.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure follows a common pattern in Chinese where the time element is placed at the beginning of the sentence.

words.definition: Sirius (name of a star, also known as the Dog Star)

sentences.text: 赫敏拿起《预言家日报》说：“那女人还不知道克劳奇的事！
sentences.translation: Hermione picked up the Daily Prophet and said, 'That woman still doesn't know about Crouch's matter!'
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Verb + Object. The possessive particle '的' is used to indicate possession in Mandarin Chinese.

sentences.text: ”他们读小天狼星的信。
sentences.translation: They read Sirius's letter.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is Subject + Verb + Object. The possessive particle '的' is used to indicate possession or association between '小天狼星' (Sirius) and '信' (letter).

sentences.text: 小天狼星警告哈利不要半夜出去，说霍格沃茨有危险的人物。
sentences.translation: Sirius warned Harry not to go out at night, saying there are dangerous people at Hogwarts.
sentences.explanation: The structure '说...的人物' means 'people who...'. In this context, '小天狼星' refers to the character Sirius Black.

content.raw_text: 哈利生气地说：“他是谁，来教训我？”赫敏说：“他是为你担心。”哈利说：“整整一年都没人对我下手。”赫敏说：“但有人把你的名字放进了火焰杯，他们有原因。”

sentences.text: 哈利生气地说：“他是谁，来教训我？
sentences.translation: Harry angrily said, "Who is he to come and teach me?"
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Adverb + Verb + Object, which is different from English. The use of the particle 地 before the verb 生气 indicates the manner in which the action is done.

sentences.text: ”赫敏说：“他是为你担心。
sentences.translation: Hermione said: 'He is worried about you.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Verb + Object. The word '为' is used to indicate the reason or cause for someone's action.

sentences.text: ”哈利说：“整整一年都没人对我下手。
sentences.translation: Harry said: "No one has laid a hand on me for a whole year."
sentences.explanation: The structure '整整一年' emphasizes the duration of 'a whole year'. The phrase '对我下手' means 'laid a hand on me', indicating physical harm or attack.

sentences.text: ”赫敏说：“但有人把你的名字放进了火焰杯，他们有原因。
sentences.translation: Hermione said: 'But someone put your name into the Goblet of Fire, they have a reason.'
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains the structure '把...放进', which is a common way in Chinese to express 'put something into something'.
The sentence contains a closing quotation mark and an ellipsis, which indicates an omission or pause in the text.

content.raw_text: 哈利不耐烦地说：“就算有人把克鲁姆击昏后绑架了克劳奇，他们等我走开后才下手。”赫敏说：“如果你在比赛中遇难，他们可以假装是意外。”

sentences.text: 哈利不耐烦地说：“就算有人把克鲁姆击昏后绑架了克劳奇，他们等我走开后才下手。
sentences.translation: Harry impatiently said: 'Even if someone knocked out Krum and kidnapped Crouch, they only made their move after I left.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a complex structure with multiple clauses and the use of particles to indicate various grammatical functions.

words.definition: particle marking the object of a verb
particle indicating completion of an action

sentences.text: ”赫敏说：“如果你在比赛中遇难，他们可以假装是意外。
sentences.translation: Hermione said: 'If you die in the competition, they can pretend it was an accident.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a conditional structure '如果...，他们可以...' (If...they can...). The word '假装' means 'pretend' in this context.
The sentence consists of opening and closing quotation marks.

content.raw_text: 哈利被迫待在房间里，觉得霍格沃茨的场地很诱人。他和赫敏、罗恩在图书馆查找毒咒，偷偷练习。罗恩提议绑架洛丽丝夫人来练习，赫敏说：“你老是不摔在垫子上！”罗恩生气地说：“被击昏后不可能瞄得那么准。”

sentences.text: 哈利被迫待在房间里，觉得霍格沃茨的场地很诱人。
sentences.translation: Harry was forced to stay in the room, feeling the Hogwarts grounds very enticing.
sentences.explanation: This sentence demonstrates the passive voice in Chinese using the character '被'. The word '里' indicates 'inside' or 'within'. The term '诱人' means 'enticing' or 'tempting'.

sentences.text: 他和赫敏，罗恩在图书馆查找毒咒，偷偷练习。
sentences.translation: He, Hermione, and Ron secretly practiced dark curses in the library.
sentences.explanation: The sentence showcases the use of the verb '偷偷' (secretly) before the verb '练习' (practice) to indicate the secretive nature of the action.

sentences.text: 罗恩提议绑架洛丽丝夫人来练习，赫敏说：“你老是不摔在垫子上！
sentences.translation: Ron suggested kidnapping Mrs. Lestrange for practice, Hermione said, 'You always fail to land on the mat!'
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a suggestion followed by a comment. The phrase '老是不' means 'always fail to' and '摔在垫子上' means 'fail to land on the mat'.

sentences.text: ”罗恩生气地说：“被击昏后不可能瞄得那么准。
sentences.translation: Ron angrily said: "It's impossible to aim so accurately after being knocked unconscious."
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the structure of expressing impossibility using "不可能" (impossible) in Chinese. It also demonstrates the use of the passive marker "被" (by) and the adverbial phrase particle "地" (used before a verb to indicate an adverbial phrase).
The sentence is enclosed in quotation marks, indicating that it is a direct quote or a specific reference.

content.raw_text: 赫敏建议练习障碍咒。铃声响了，他们去上课。特里劳妮教授讲解火星作用，哈利感到脑袋发昏。他趁特里劳妮教授解挂在灯上的披巾时，偷偷把窗户打开了一条缝，然后靠在椅子上，感到很惬意。

sentences.text: 赫敏建议练习障碍咒。
sentences.translation: Hermione suggests practicing the impediment curse.
sentences.explanation: This sentence introduces the concept of practicing a specific curse in the context of the story.

sentences.text: 铃声响了，他们去上课。
sentences.translation: The bell rang, and they went to class.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes the action of the bell ringing, signaling that it's time for class, and the subsequent action of 'they' going to class. Pay attention to the use of '去' to indicate the movement towards a place.

sentences.text: 特里劳妮教授讲解火星作用，哈利感到脑袋发昏。
sentences.translation: Professor Trelawney explains the effect of Mars, Harry feels dizzy.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is Subject + Verb + Object. The tricky part might be the use of the word '发昏' which means 'dizzy' in this context.

sentences.text: 他趁特里劳妮教授解挂在灯上的披巾时，偷偷把窗户打开了一条缝，然后靠在椅子上，感到很惬意。
sentences.translation: He took advantage of Professor Terri Lao Ni untying the scarf hanging on the lamp to secretly open the window a crack, then leaned back in the chair, feeling very comfortable.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of the verb '趁' to indicate taking advantage of a situation. It also includes the structure '趁...时' to show the timing of the action taken.

words.definition: particle used to shift the object to before the verb

content.raw_text: 哈利做了一个梦，梦见自己骑在猫头鹰背上，飞到一座老房子。房子里有个秃顶的矮个男人和一条大蛇。一个冷酷的声音说：“虫尾巴，你真走运。”哈利听见伏地魔的声音，感到伤疤疼痛。

sentences.text: 哈利做了一个梦，梦见自己骑在猫头鹰背上，飞到一座老房子。
sentences.translation: Harry had a dream, dreaming of himself riding on the back of an owl, flying to an old house.
sentences.explanation: The structure '梦见自己' means 'dreaming of oneself' and '飞到' means 'flying to'.

sentences.text: 房子里有个秃顶的矮个男人和一条大蛇。
sentences.translation: In the house, there is a bald short man and a big snake.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the measure words '个' for people and '条' for long, narrow objects like snakes. It also demonstrates the possessive particle '的' to indicate the relationship between '秃顶' (bald) and '男人' (man).

words.definition: a (measure word for long, narrow objects like snakes)

sentences.text: 一个冷酷的声音说：“虫尾巴，你真走运。
sentences.translation: A cold voice said: "Insect tail, you are really lucky."
sentences.explanation: The phrase '虫尾巴' (insect tail) is likely a nickname or derogatory term used by the speaker towards the listener.

sentences.text: ”哈利听见伏地魔的声音，感到伤疤疼痛。
sentences.translation: Harry heard Voldemort's voice, felt the scar hurting.
sentences.explanation: The possessive particle '的' is used to indicate that the voice belongs to Voldemort. The structure '感到' is used to express feeling in Chinese.

content.raw_text: 哈利醒来，发现自己躺在地上，罗恩在他身边。特里劳妮教授兴奋地问：“波特，你看见了什么？”哈利撒谎说：“没什么。”他站起来，决定去找邓布利多。

sentences.text: 哈利醒来，发现自己躺在地上，罗恩在他身边。
sentences.translation: Harry woke up and found himself lying on the ground, with Ron beside him.
sentences.explanation: The structure '发现自己' means 'found oneself', which is a common way to express waking up and realizing one's situation in Chinese.

sentences.text: 特里劳妮教授兴奋地问：“波特，你看见了什么？
sentences.translation: Professor Trelawney excitedly asked, 'Potter, what did you see?'
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is Subject-Verb-Object, with the question word '什么' (what) at the end. The particle '了' indicates the completion of the action of seeing.

sentences.text: ”哈利撒谎说：“没什么。
sentences.translation: Harry lied and said: 'Nothing.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence shows Harry lying by saying 'nothing.' The use of the opening and closing quotation marks indicates direct speech.

sentences.text: ”他站起来，决定去找邓布利多。
sentences.translation: He stood up, determined to go find Dumbledore.
sentences.explanation: The structure '决定去' means 'determined to go', where the verb '决定' (determined) is followed by '去' (to go) to indicate the intention or decision to do something.

content.raw_text: 哈利走到邓布利多办公室，发现门口有个石头怪兽。他不知道口令，试了几个糖果名字，最后怪兽跳开了。他走上楼梯，听见办公室里有人说话。

sentences.text: 哈利走到邓布利多办公室，发现门口有个石头怪兽。
sentences.translation: Harry walked to Dumbledore's office and found a stone monster at the door.
sentences.explanation: The structure '发现...有...' is a common way to express 'found something/someone at a certain place' in Chinese.

sentences.text: 他不知道口令，试了几个糖果名字，最后怪兽跳开了。
sentences.translation: He didn't know the password, tried several candy names, and finally the monster jumped away.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is subject + verb + object. The particle '了' is used to indicate the completion of an action.

sentences.text: 他走上楼梯，听见办公室里有人说话。
sentences.translation: He walked up the stairs and heard people talking in the office.
sentences.explanation: The structure '听见...说话' is a common way to express 'heard someone talking' in Chinese.

content.raw_text: 福吉说：“我认为伯莎迷路了，没有发现行凶迹象。”穆迪说：“波特有话要对你说，他就在门外。”

sentences.text: 福吉说：“我认为伯莎迷路了，没有发现行凶迹象。
sentences.translation: Fukichi said: 'I think Bessa got lost and did not discover any signs of the crime.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is straightforward, with a subject-verb-object pattern. The use of 了 indicates the completion of an action, and 行凶迹象 refers to signs of the crime.

words.definition: particle indicating completion of an action

sentences.text: ”穆迪说：“波特有话要对你说，他就在门外。
sentences.translation: Moody said: 'Potter has something to tell you, he's right outside the door.'
sentences.explanation: The structure '要对你说' means 'has something to tell you'. The use of '就' emphasizes the immediacy or closeness of the action, in this case, Potter being right outside the door.
This sentence only contains a closing quotation mark.
